summary: Mesoblast Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 25, 2026, reporting its August 24, 2026 ASX filings. The exhibits include a Change of Director's Interest Notice (Appendix 3Y) and a Notification of Issue of Unquoted Equity Securities (Appendix 3G). The director's notice discloses Philip R. Krause acquired 875,000 options (issued with shareholder approval at the 2025 AGM) for nil consideration, increasing his holdings to 3,385,000 options plus 28,750 ADSs. The Appendix 3G reports the issue of unquoted equity securities. These are routine administrative disclosures regarding director option grants and security issuances under Australian listing rules, not constituting a special situation for US purposes. There are no deal terms, acquisitions, or strategic actions to analyze.
